verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows BugSnag's own AI analyzing a stack trace, breadcrumbs and commits to propose a root cause. What the docs do show is related but different: rule-based error grouping, correlated events, release correlation, and an official MCP server that lets outside agents connect. None of these is the platform itself producing an AI root-cause analysis, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's AI analyzes an issue — stack trace, breadcrumbs, related commits — and proposes a root cause I can act on
